notes:
**Fixes the 1.27.0 startup crash.** 1.27.0 showed "ChatOSS hit a rendering error" on every launch, and Reload didn't help. 1.27.1 starts normally again, and your chats, settings and apps are all kept.

**If you installed 1.27.0,** it can't update itself because the crash happens before the Update button appears. Reinstall once with the installer below. It replaces only the app; your data is kept.
- **macOS:** quit ChatOSS, then run `curl -fsSL https://chatoss.ai/install.sh | sh` in Terminal, or download the `.dmg` below.
- **Linux:** the same command installs the AppImage. If you installed the `.deb`, install the new `.deb` below instead.
- **Windows:** download and run `ChatOSS_1.27.1_x64-setup.exe` below.

**If a startup error ever happens again,** the error screen now shows the actual error message and has an **Update ChatOSS** button, so a fixed version can be installed right from that screen.

Download the installer for your platform below.

**macOS:** download the signed + notarized universal `ChatOSS_<version>_universal.dmg` — one build that runs natively on both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs — built and uploaded from a developer machine with the Apple Developer ID certificate.
**Windows:** ChatOSS_*_x64-setup.exe
**Linux:** ChatOSS_*_amd64.AppImage or .deb
